spec.description: MeshTLSAuthentication defines a list of authenticated client IDs to be referenced by an `AuthorizationPolicy`. If a client connection has the mutually-authenticated identity that matches ANY of the of the provided identities, the connection is considered authenticated.

identities.description:
Authorizes clients with the provided proxy identity strings (as provided via MTLS)
The `*` prefix can be used to match all identities in a domain. An identity string of `*` indicates that all authentication clients are authorized.
